// This file wrote testdata/upgrade/89f2ca3/configmaps.json at commit 89f2ca3. It is a .txt so
// `go test ./...` never compiles it. To regenerate at a release bump, copy it to
// internal/store/kubestore/gen_fixture_test.go at that commit and run:
//
//	FIXTURE_OUT=$PWD/testdata/upgrade/89f2ca3/configmaps.json go test ./internal/store/kubestore -run TestGenFixture
package kubestore_test

import (
	"context"
	"crypto/rand"
	"encoding/json"
	"os"
	"testing"
	"time"

	corev1 "k8s.io/api/core/v1"
	metav1 "k8s.io/apimachinery/pkg/apis/meta/v1"
	"sigs.k8s.io/controller-runtime/pkg/client"
	"sigs.k8s.io/controller-runtime/pkg/client/fake"

	"github.com/popododo0720/vws-compute/internal/compute"
	"github.com/popododo0720/vws-compute/internal/store"
	"github.com/popododo0720/vws-compute/internal/store/kubestore"
)

func must[T any](v T, err error) T {
	if err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}
	return v
}

func TestGenFixture(t *testing.T) {
	ctx := context.Background()
	const ns = "vws"
	c := fake.NewClientBuilder().Build()
	s := kubestore.New(c, ns)
	now := time.Date(2026, 10, 20, 9, 0, 0, 0, time.UTC)
	env := compute.Env{Now: now, Rand: rand.Reader}

	keyName, err := compute.ParseKeyName("legacy-rsa-8192")
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	pk, err := compute.ParsePublicKey(rsa8192Line)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	keySpec := compute.KeyPairSpec{
		ID: must(compute.ParseKeyPairID("key-0123456789abcdef0")), Generation: 1,
		CreatedAt: now, ChangedAt: now, Name: keyName, PublicKey: pk,
	}
	kin, err := compute.NewImportKeyPair(keyName.String(), rsa8192Line, compute.Labels{})
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	kop, err := compute.NewOperation(env, must(compute.ParseRequestID("req-key-1")), kin, compute.Change{Spec: keySpec, Write: true})
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if _, err := s.CommitDesired(ctx, store.DesiredChange{Op: kop, Spec: keySpec, Write: true}); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}

	imgID := "img-0123456789abcdef0"
	instID := "i-0123456789abcdef0"
	typ := must(compute.ParseInstanceType("vws.small"))
	instSpec := compute.InstanceSpec{
		ID: must(compute.ParseInstanceID(instID)), Generation: 1, CreatedAt: now, ChangedAt: now,
		Image: must(compute.ParseImageID(imgID)), Type: typ,
		Key: &compute.AuthorizedKey{Name: keyName, PublicKey: pk}, Power: compute.PowerRunning,
	}
	iin, err := compute.NewRunInstance(imgID, "vws.small", keyName.String())
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	iop, err := compute.NewOperation(env, must(compute.ParseRequestID("req-inst-1")), iin, compute.Change{Spec: instSpec, Write: true})
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if _, err := s.CommitDesired(ctx, store.DesiredChange{Op: iop, Spec: instSpec, Write: true}); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}

	var list corev1.ConfigMapList
	if err := c.List(ctx, &list, client.InNamespace(ns)); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	list.TypeMeta = metav1.TypeMeta{APIVersion: "v1", Kind: "List"}
	for i := range list.Items {
		list.Items[i].CreationTimestamp = metav1.NewTime(now)
	}
	out, err := json.MarshalIndent(list, "", "  ")
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	path := os.Getenv("FIXTURE_OUT")
	if path == "" {
		t.Fatal("FIXTURE_OUT is unset")
	}
	if err := os.WriteFile(path, append(out, '\n'), 0o644); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
}
